scope: Diagnostic decomposition of first selected formal pair; not the three-pair campaign verdict or a causal attribution
redaction: Host paths, request IDs, timestamps, audio paths, reference/generated/ASR text omitted; all 256 ordered per-utterance metric rows retained. Originals remain private. Output SHA256 is registered in tools/evidence_inventory.json.
limitations: Word comparison lowercases and extracts Unicode word tokens; it is not the native ASR WER normalizer.
Identical emitted Thinker text does not establish identical hidden-state conditioning.
Audio/ASR divergence does not isolate Talker, codec, first-frame delivery, scorer behavior, or stochastic/numerical effects.
Outlier decomposition retains every row and does not alter acceptance arithmetic.
